profile.headline: Software Engineer Specialist
profile.summary:
My professional experience includes:

-	Software Development using C# and Visual Studios, PHP, Symfony, and Java.
-	Data Base Management using SQL Server, MySQL, and Postgres.

Other skills
-	Software Development Using Qt C++.
-	Installation and Configuration of Ubuntu Servers.
-	Use of Data Mining Tools including Weka, RapidMainer, Pentaho and SQL-Server.
-	Scientific certification of Junior Researcher.

I have worked on the following projects:

1- Federal (National) Project - Expert System for Water Quality Control.
2- Technological Scientific Service: System for the Supervision and Control of Water Quality. 
3 - Technological Scientific Service: Automatic System Control for a Planetarium GOTO 2230 GX.
 4- Software Research and Development Using Real Time Systems.
I have published results of my research projects and also presented them in scientific events.

positions.title: Software Engineer Specialist
positions.description:
I have worked on the following projects:

1.	Technological Scientific Service: Automatic System Control for a Planetarium GOTO 2230 GX.
-	Study of Software Development Tools with Virtual Instrumentation for Typical Applications of Automatic Control.
-	Use of Rational Unified Process (RUP) to Document Software Development.
-	Development of a User Interface Windows Application Using C#.
-	Development of a User Interface Linux Application Using Qt C++.
2.	Software Research and Development Using Real Time Systems.
-	Development of a User Interface Linux Application Using Qt C++.
-	Development of a Data Base.
3.	Federal (National) Project - Expert System for Water Quality Control.
-	Algorithm of Fuzzy Logic to Obtain Indexes of Water Quality Using XFuzzy Software.
-	 Prototype of Web Application Based on the Results of the Fuzzy Logic Algorithm.
4.	Technological Scientific Service: System for the Supervision and Control of Water Quality. 
-	 Development of a Web Application for the Supervision and Control of Water Quality (SSCA).
-	 Research on the Most Relevant Aspects of Website Security.
-	 Validation of Data Security on the SSCA Web Application.
